# milvaion_job (Data Source)

Look up a job by id or by display name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look a job up by its display name (it must be unique) or by id.
data "milvaion_job" "cleanup" {
  name = "cleanup-temp-files"
}

output "cleanup_schedule" {
  value = data.milvaion_job.cleanup.cron_expression
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Job id. Set id or name.
- `name` (String) Display name. Must match exactly one job.

### Read-Only

- `auto_disable` (Attributes) Auto-disable settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--auto_disable))
- `concurrent_execution_policy` (String) Skip or Queue.
- `cron_expression` (String) Cron expression, empty for one-time jobs.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `execute_at` (String) Time of a one-time run.
- `execution_timeout_seconds` (Number) Execution timeout in seconds.
- `external_job_id` (String) Identifier in the external scheduler.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the job is dispatched.
- `is_external` (Boolean) Reported by an external scheduler.
- `job_data` (String) JSON payload.
- `job_name` (String) Job type on the worker.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags.
- `worker_id` (String) Worker that runs the job.
- `zombie_timeout_minutes` (Number) Queued timeout in minutes.

<a id="nestedatt--auto_disable"></a>
### Nested Schema for `auto_disable`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `failure_window_minutes` (Number)
- `threshold` (Number)
